items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: The name 'Tony' is mentioned by the interviewer addressing a third party ('Tony, what do you think...'), with no interaction or relationship described between the interviewee and Tony.

ctx.x: Well, for your information, the Jazz Institute at Rutgers University will send you tapes if you request anything. So anything you might want in the way of jazz, you should write to the Jazz Institute at Rutgers. They'll send you tapes. The archives is, you know, is really doing it backwards.
Tony, what do you think would be better? A stationary mic? Should we have a mic stand? Why don't we test?
I'm not going to say anything unless it's ultimately necessary. Okay. I just don't think people want to...
